description: This file defines the class 'CohereRerankV2Config', which extends 'CohereRerankConfig' and provides methods for constructing URLs, supported parameters, parameter mapping, and transforming rerank requests specific to Cohere's reranking API version 2.

classes.name: CohereRerankV2Config
classes.description: Configuration class for Cohere rerank API v2, providing URL construction, parameter support, mapping, and request transformation methods.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for the rerank API endpoint based on the provided base URL and model.

methods.name: list get_supported_cohere_rerank_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for the Cohere rerank API.

methods.name: Dict map_cohere_rerank_params( self, non_default_params: Optional[dict], model: str, drop_params: bool, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Maps input parameters to the format expected by the rerank request, returning a dictionary.

methods.name: dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms parameters into a rerank request dictionary suitable for API submission, including validation.
